name: HH breakout 14 — expansion-continuation pullback entry (1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: separates the SIGNAL (a confirmed vol expansion / trend birth) from the ENTRY (a low-cost pullback), addressing the fact that chasing the breakout bar itself is where fakeouts and slippage eat you. Once bb_width has EXPANDED above a floor (from a compressed base) AND adx is in trend territory, a real directional regime is established — the squeeze has already RESOLVED. Rather than enter on the extended break bar, we wait for range_position to PULL BACK toward mid-range (below a fitted ceiling) within the now-trending regime and enter long in the trend direction, buying from the late fakeout-faders shorting the pullback into a real trend. Lower entry cost and better R:R than the raw break. Economically distinct from the squeeze-break variants (01/03) because the entry is a mid-range pullback, not the extreme. bar_size 1h. DISCONFIRMER: KILL if pullbacks after a confirmed expansion revert to the FULL prior range as often as they resume the trend (no 'trend holds the pullback' effect net of fees), OR if the two-stage pullback entry does not beat the one-stage break entry on holdout (the wait just misses the move), OR if the adx-cross condition leaks (adx smoothing peeks forward) — verify PIT on adx.
catalyst: pullback within a confirmed post-expansion uptrend
